summary.text: Allen Davis is a Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Cheshire 18, a two-seat district, in the November 3, 2026 general election, alongside Rory Lovett Sherman. His career experience includes working as an educator.

paragraphs.text: Allen Davis and Rory Lovett Sherman advanced from the Democratic primary for Cheshire 18 on September 8, 2026, and face incumbent Republicans Rita Mattson and Jim Qualey in the general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Davis described himself as an educator and nonprofit leader who brings together people who disagree, and said he lives in Dublin.

He listed his key messages as making New Hampshire affordable, with more state funding for public schools and public higher education, and creating opportunity for young people and families, retirement security, lower student debt and affordable housing.
